G3100.def:
μαθητεύω
(μαθητής), 
__1. intrans. (as prop. vb. in -εύω, and so Plut., mor. 837 with and elsew.), to be a disciple: with dative, Matthieu 27:57 (Rec., WH, mg.). 
__2. Trans., to make a disciple: with accusative, Matthieu 28:19, Actes 14:21; pass., before dative, τ. Ἰησοῦ, Matthieu 27:57 (WH, R); τ. βασιλείᾳ, Matthieu 13:52.†

G3101.def:
μαθητής, -οῦ, ὁ (μανθάνω), 
[in LXX only as seel. (A) in Jérémie 13:21 20:11 26(46):9 * ;] 
a disciple: opposite to διδάσκαλος, Matthieu 10:24, Luc 6:40; Ἰωάννου, Matthieu 9:14, Luc 7:18, Jean 3:25; τ. Φαρισσίων, Matthieu 22:16, Marc 2:18, Luc 5:33; Μωυσέως, Jean 9:28; Ἰησοῦ, Luc 6:17 7:11 19:37, Jean 6:66 7:3 19:38; esp. the twelve, Matthieu 10:1 11:1, Marc 7:17, Luc 8:9, Jo 2:2, al.; later, of Christians generally, Actes 6:1, 2 7 9:19, al.; τ. κυρίου, Actes 9:1.

G3102.def:
μαθήτρια, -ας, ἡ
(= μαθητρίς, fem, of μαθητής, which see) 
a female disciple: Actes 9:36.†

G3104.def:
Μεννά (L, Μεννᾶς, -ᾶ; Rec. Μαϊνάν) ὁ, 
Menna: Luc 3:31.†

G3105.def:
μαίνομαι 
[in LXX: Jérémie 25:16 (הָלַל hith.) Jérémie 29:26 (שָׁגַע pu.), Wis.14:28, a). ;] 
__1. to rage, be furious. 
__2. to rave, be mad: Jean 10:29, Actes 12:15 26:24-25, 1 Corinthiens 14:23 (cf. ἐμ-μαίνομαι).†

G3106.def:
μακαρζω
(μακάριος), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pi., pu. ;] 
to bless, pronounce blessed or happy: with accusative of person(s), Luc 1:48, Jacques 5:11.†

G3107.def:
μακάριος, -α, -ον
(collat. form of poët. μάκαρ, in Hom., Hes., chiefly of the gods and the departed), [in LXX for אֹשֶׁר ;] 
blessed, happy (DCG, i, 177, 213): θεός (δυνάστης), 1 Timothée 1:11 6:15; ἐλπίς, Tite 2:13; esp. in congratulations, usually with the omission of the copula (M, Pr., 180; B1., § 30, 3), μ. ὁ, Matthieu 5:3 ff., Luc 6:20 ff. Jean 20:29, Apocalypse 1:3, al.; before ptcp., Luc 1:45, al.; ὅς, Matthieu 11:6, Luc 7:23, Romains 4:7-8; ὅτι, Matthieu 13:16, al.; ἐάν, Jean 13:17, 1 Corinthiens 7:40; compar., μ. . . . μᾶλλον, Actes 20:35; -ώτερος, 1 Corinthiens 7:40 
SYN.: εὐλογητός, q.v

G3108.def:
μακαρισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(μακαρίζω) 
a declaration of blessedness, felicitation: Romains 4:6, 9, Galates 4:15 (Plat., Arist.).†

G3109.def:
Μακεδονία, -ας, ἡ 
Macedonia: Actes 16:9-10, 1 Corinthiens 16:5, 2 Corinthiens 1:16, Philippiens 4:15, al.; M. καὶ Ἀχαία, Actes 19:21, Romains 15:26, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:7-8

G3110.def:
Μακεδών, -όνος, ὁ 
a Macedonian: Actes 16:9 19:29 27:2, 2 Corinthiens 9:2 9:4.†

G3111.def:
μάκελλον, -ου, τό (Lat. macellum), 
a meat-market: 1 Corinthiens 10:25 (see Deiss., LAE, 274; MM, xvi).†

G3112.def:
μακράν (prop. fem. accusative of μακρός, Sc. ὁδόν), adv. ,
[in LXX for רָחוֹק hi., רָחַק, etc. ;] 
a long way, far: Luc 15:20, Actes 22:21; before ἀπό, Matthieu 8:30, Luc 7:6, Jean 21:8, Actes 17:27; id. metaphorically, Marc 12:34; οἱ εἰς μ., Actes 2:39 (cf. Ésaïe 2:2); metaphorically, οἱ ποτὲ ὄντες μ. (opposite to ἐγγύς), Éphésiens 2:13; οἱ μ., Éphésiens 2:17.†

G3113.def:
μακρόθεν
(μακρός), 
adv. (chiefly late), 
[in LXX for רָחוֹק, רָחַק, etc. ;] 
from afar, afar: Luc 18:13 22:54; ἀπὸ μ. (Psaumes 138:6, Esther 3:13, al.), Matthieu 26:58 27:55, Marc 5:6 8:3 11:13 14:54 15:40, Luc 16:23 23:49, Apocalypse 18:10, 15 18:17.†

G3114.def:
μακροθυμέω, -ῶ
(μακρό-θυμος, long-tempered; see: -ία), [in LXX: Ecclésiaste 8:12 א2, Proverbes 19:11 (אָרַךְ, אַף אָרַךְ), Job 7:16, Sir.2:4, al. ;] 
__1. actively = καρτερέω, to persevere (Plut., 2, 593 F). 
__2. Passively, to be patient, long-suffering: absol., 1 Corinthiens 13:4, Hébreux 6:15, Jacques 5:8; before ἕως, with genitive, Jacques 5:7; ἐπί, with dative, ib. (Sir.2:4); πρός, with accusative, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:14; ἐπί, with dative, Matthieu 18:26, 29, Luc 18:7; εἰς, 2 Pierre 3:9.†
SYN.: ὑπομένω, q.v

G3115.def:
μακροθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(μακρό-θυμος), [in LXX: Proverbes 25:15 (אַף אֹרֶךְ), Jérémie 15:15 (אַף אָרֵךְ) Ésaïe 57:15, Sir.5:11, 1Ma.8:4 * ;], 
patience, longsuffering: of men, esp. in experiencing troubles and difficulties, Colossiens 1:11, 2 Timothée 3:10, Hébreux 6:12, Jacques 5:10; of God's forbearance, Romains 2:4 9:22, 2 Corinthiens 6:6, Galates 5:22, Éphésiens 4:2, Colossiens 3:12, 1 Timothée 1:16, 2 Timothée 4:2, 1 Pierre 3:20, 2 Pierre 3:15.†
SYN.: ὑπομονή (cf. Lft., Col., 138; Tr., Syn., liii)

G3116.def:
μακροθύμως 
adv., 
with forbearance, patiently: Actes 26:3.†

G3117.def:
μακρός, -ά, -όν 
[in LXX for אָרֹךְ, רָחוֹק and cognate forms, etc. ;] 
of space and time, long: μακρὰ προσεύχεσθαι, Marc 12:40, Luc 20:47. 
of distance, far, far distant: χώρα, Luc 15:13 19:12.†

G3118.def:
μακρο-χρόνιος, -ον
(μακρός, χρόνος), [in LXX. μ. γίγνεσθαι, εἶναι (יוֹם אָרַךְ), Exode 20:12, Deutéronome 4:40 5:16 17:20 * ;] 
of long duration, longlived: Éphésiens 6:3 (LXX).†

G3119.def:
μαλακία -ας, ἡ
(μαλακός), [in LXX chiefly for חֳלִי Deutéronome 7:15 28:61, Ésaïe 38:9 53:3, al. ;] 
__1. prop., softness, effeminacy (Hdt., Thuc., al). 
__2. In NT, as in LXX, = ἀσθένεια, weakness, sickness: νόσος καὶ μ., Matthieu 4:23 9:35 10:1.†
SYN.: see: ἀσθένεια

G3121.def:
Μαλελεήλ (T, Μελ-), ὁ (Heb. מַהֲלַלְאֵל), 
Mahalaleel: Luc 3:37.†

G3122.def:
μάλιστα, see: μάλα.
μάλα 
adv., [in LXX for אֲבָל, 3Ki.1:43, Dan LXX 10:21, al.; compar. for מ, Nombres 13:32 (31), al.; μᾶλλον ἠ (מ), Genèse 19:9, al.; superlat., 2Ma.8:7, 4Ma.4:22 12:9 15:4 ;] 
__I. Pos., very, very much, exceedingly (cl.; LXX ut supr.; in NT its place is taken by λίαν, σφόδρα, etc.). 
__II. Compar., μᾶλλον. 
__1. Of increase, more; with qualifying words: πολλῷ, Marc 10:48, Luc 18:39, Romains 5:15, 17, Philippiens 2:12, al.; πόσῳ, Luc 12:24, Romains 11:12, al.; τοσούτῳ . . . ὅσῳ, Hébreux 10:25. 
__2. Of comparison, the more: Luc 5:15, Jean 5:18, Actes 5:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:1, 10, 2 Pierre 1:10; ἔτι μ. καὶ μ., Philippiens 1:9; with compar., Marc 7:36, 2 Corinthiens 7:13; πολλῴ μ. κρεῖσον, Philippiens 1:23; μ. διαφέρειν, with genitive, Matthieu 6:26; μ. ἤ, Matthieu 18:13; with genitive, 1 Corinthiens 14:18; as periphr. for compar., Actes 20:35, 1 Corinthiens 9:15, Galates 4:27; μ. δέ (EV, yea rather), Romains 8:34. 
__3. Of preference, rather, the rather, sooner: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, Matthieu 6:30, al.; πολύ, Hébreux 12:25; πόσῳ, Matthieu 7:11, al.; in a question, οὐ μ., 1 Corinthiens 9:12; after a neg., Matthieu 10:6, al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., 1 Corinthiens 14:5, 2 Corinthiens 5:8; ζηλῶ, 1 Corinthiens 14:1; with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, Jean 3:19; μ. δέ, Galates 4:9. 
__III. Superl., μάλιστα
, most, most of all, above all: Actes 20:38 25:26, Galates 6:10, Philippiens 4:22, 1 Timothée 4:10 5:8, 17, 2 Timothée 4:13, Tite 1:10, Phm 16, 2 Pierre 2:10; μ. γνώστης, Actes 26:3

G3123G.def:
μάλα 
adv., [in LXX for אֲבָל, 3Ki.1:43, Dan LXX 10:21, al.; compar. for מ, Nombres 13:32 (31), al.; μᾶλλον ἠ (מ), Genèse 19:9, al.; superlat., 2Ma.8:7, 4Ma.4:22 12:9 15:4 ;] 
__I. Pos., very, very much, exceedingly (cl.; LXX ut supr.; in NT its place is taken by λίαν, σφόδρα, etc.). 
__II. Compar., μᾶλλον. 
__1. Of increase, more; with qualifying words: πολλῷ, Marc 10:48, Luc 18:39, Romains 5:15, 17, Philippiens 2:12, al.; πόσῳ, Luc 12:24, Romains 11:12, al.; τοσούτῳ . . . ὅσῳ, Hébreux 10:25. 
__2. Of comparison, the more: Luc 5:15, Jean 5:18, Actes 5:14, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:1, 10, 2 Pierre 1:10; ἔτι μ. καὶ μ., Philippiens 1:9; with compar., Marc 7:36, 2 Corinthiens 7:13; πολλῴ μ. κρεῖσον, Philippiens 1:23; μ. διαφέρειν, with genitive, Matthieu 6:26; μ. ἤ, Matthieu 18:13; with genitive, 1 Corinthiens 14:18; as periphr. for compar., Actes 20:35, 1 Corinthiens 9:15, Galates 4:27; μ. δέ (EV, yea rather), Romains 8:34. 
__3. Of preference, rather, the rather, sooner: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, Matthieu 6:30, al.; πολύ, Hébreux 12:25; πόσῳ, Matthieu 7:11, al.; in a question, οὐ μ., 1 Corinthiens 9:12; after a neg., Matthieu 10:6, al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., 1 Corinthiens 14:5, 2 Corinthiens 5:8; ζηλῶ, 1 Corinthiens 14:1; with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, Jean 3:19; μ. δέ, Galates 4:9. 
__III. Superl., μάλιστα
, most, most of all, above all: Actes 20:38 25:26, Galates 6:10, Philippiens 4:22, 1 Timothée 4:10 5:8, 17, 2 Timothée 4:13, Tite 1:10, Phm 16, 2 Pierre 2:10; μ. γνώστης, Actes 26:3

G3123H.def:
μάλα 
adv., [in LXX for אֲבָל, 3Ki.1:43, Dan LXX 10:21, al.; compar. for מ, Nombres 13:32 (31), al.; μᾶλλον ἠ (מ), Genèse 19:9, al.; superlat., 2Ma.8:7, 4Ma.4:22 12:9 15:4 ;]

__3. Of preference, rather, the rather, sooner: with qualifying words, πολλῷ, Matthieu 6:30, al.; πολύ, Hébreux 12:25; πόσῳ, Matthieu 7:11, al.; in a question, οὐ μ., 1 Corinthiens 9:12; after a neg., Matthieu 10:6, al.; θέλω (εὐδοκῶ) μ., 1 Corinthiens 14:5, 2 Corinthiens 5:8; ζηλῶ, 1 Corinthiens 14:1; with subst., τ. σκότος ἢ τ. φῶς, Jean 3:19; μ. δέ, Galates 4:9. 
__III. Superl., μάλιστα
, most, most of all, above all: Actes 20:38 25:26, Galates 6:10, Philippiens 4:22, 1 Timothée 4:10 5:8, 17, 2 Timothée 4:13, Tite 1:10, Phm 16, 2 Pierre 2:10; μ. γνώστης, Actes 26:3

G3124.def:
Μάλχος, -ου, ὁ (Hellenistic form of Heb. מֶלֶךְ), 
Malchus: Jean 18:10.†

G3125.def:
μάμμη, -ης, ἡ
(onomatop.), [in LXX: 4Ma.16:9 * ;] 
__1. in cl., a child's name for mother. 
__2. In late Gk. (= cl., τήθη), a grandmother: (LXX, l.with), 2 Timothée 1:5.†

G3126.def:
μαμωνᾶς (Rec. μαμμ-), -ᾶ (Bl., § 7, 4), ό (Aram. מָמוֺנָא), 
mammon, riches: Matthieu 6:24, Luc 16:9, 11 16:13.†

G3129.def:
μανθάνω 
[in LXX chiefly for לָמַד ;] 
__1. to learn, esp. by inquiry: absol., 1 Corinthiens 14:31, 1 Timothée 2:11, 2 Timothée 3:7; with accusative of thing(s), Jean 7:15 (sc. αὐτά), Romains 16:17, 1 Corinthiens 14:35, Philippiens 4:9, 2 Timothée 3:14, Apocalypse 14:3; before quaes. indir., Matthieu 9:13; Χριστόν, Éphésiens 4:20 (ICC, in l); before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s), Matthieu 24:32, Marc 13:28; ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 11:29, Colossiens 1:7; παρά, with genitive of person(s), 2 Timothée 3:14; ἐν, with dative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 4:6; "point" aorist (M, Pr., 117), to ascertain, before ὅτι, Actes 23:27; with accusative before ἀπό, Galates 3:2. 
__2. to learn by use and practice, acquire the habit of, be accustomed to: with inf. (Bl., § 69, 4), 1 Timothée 5:4, Tite 3:14; id. with nom, in pred. (El., § 72, 1), Philippiens 4:11; with accusative of thing(s) before ἀπό, Hébreux 5:8; ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν (EV, they learn to be idle; Bl., § 73, 5; Field, Notes, 210), 1 Timothée 5:13.†

G3130.def:
μανία, -ας, ἡ
(μαίνομαι) [in LXX: Osée 9:7-8 מַשְׂטֵמָה), Wis.5:4, al. ;] 
frenzy, madness: Actes 26:24.†

G3131.def:
μάννα, τό ,
(in FlJ, also ἡ), 
indecl. 
[in LXX: τὸ μάν, Exode 16:31 ff., elsewhere τ. μάννα, Nombres 11:6 ff., al. (מָן, Aram. מַנָּא) ;] 
manna: Jean 6:31, 49, Hébreux 9:4; symb., Apocalypse 2:17.†

G3132.def:
μαντεύομαι
(μαντίς, a seer, diviner), [in LXX for קָסַם, Deutéronome 18:10, al. ;] 
to divine, practise divination: Actes 16:16.†
SYN.: προφητεύω, which see, in distinction from which μ. is used in LXX and NT only of false prophets and those who practise the heathen arts of divination and soothsaying (cf. 1 Rois 28:8, and see Tr., Syn., § vi)

G3133.def:
μαραίνω 
[in LXX: Job 15:30 (יָבֵשׁ pi.), Job 24:24, Wis.2:8 19:21 * ;] 
in cl., 
__1. prop., to quench fire; pass., of fire, to die away, go out. 
__2. In various relations, to quench, waste, wear out (cf. Wis.19:21); pass., to waste away; in later writers (Plut., Luc., al.), of the withering of flowers and herbage (act., Job 15:30; pass., Job 24:24, Wis.2:8): Jacques 1:11 (cf. ἀμάραντον).†

G3134.def:
μαρὰν ἀθά (Rec. μαραναθά; Aram.: on the original form see Dalman, Gr., § 41, 1; 74, 3; Words, 328), 
Maranatha, i.e. the Lord cometh (but see Dalman, ll. with; Field, Notes, 180; ICC, in l): 1 Corinthiens 16:22.†

G3135.def:
μαργαρίτης, -ου, ὁ 
a pearl: Matthieu 13:45-46, 1 Timothée 2:9, Apocalypse 17:4 18:12, 16 21:21 (-ῖται, WH); proverbially, Matthieu 7:6.†

G3136.def:
Μάρθα, -ας (Bl., § 7, 2), ἡ (Aram. מָרְתָּא), 
Martha: Luc 10:38, 40-41, Jean 11:1, 5 11:19 ff. Luc 12:2.†

G3137G.def:
Μαρία, -ας (Hellenized form), and Μαριάμ, indecl., ἡ (Aram. מַרְיָם; Heb. מִרְיָם) 
Mary. In NT; 
__1. the mother of Jesus: Matthieu 1:16 ff. Matthieu 2:11 13:55, Marc 6:3, Luc 1:27 ff. Luc 2:5, 16 2:19, 34, Actes 1:14 
__2. M. Magdalene (which see). 
__3. The wife of Clopas (Jean 19:25) and mother of James the little, and Joses: Matthieu 27:56, 61 28:1, Marc 15:40, 47 16:1, Luc 24:10. 
__4. The sister of Martha and Lazarus: Luc 10:39, 42 Jean 11:1-2, 19 ff. Jean 12:3. 
__5. The mother of John Mark: Actes 12:12. 
__6. A Christian greeted by St. Paul: Romains 16:6 (on the signification of the name, see Zorell, see word; on the use of the alternative forms in NT, DB, iii, 278 bn).†

G3137I.def:
Μαρία, -ας (Hellenized form), and Μαριάμ, indecl., ἡ (Aram. מַרְיָם; Heb. מִרְיָם)

G3138.def:
Μάρκος, -ου, ὁ, 
Mark: Mk., title., Actes 12:12, 25 15:37, 39, Colossiens 4:10, 2 Timothée 4:11, Phm 24, 1 Pierre 5:13 (see Swete, Mk., Intr., xiii ff.; DB, iii, 245 ff).†

G3139.def:
μάρμαρος, -ου, ὁ
(μαρμαίρω, to glisten), [in LXX: Ep. Jérémie 7:2 * ;] 
__1. any crystalline stone (Hom., Eur., al.). 
__2. In later writers, marble: Apocalypse 18:12.†

G3140.def:
μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
(μάρτυς), [in LXX chiefly for עֵד (עֵד (Genèse 31:47-48, al.), also for עוּד hi. (Genèse 43:3, La 2:13), עָנָה (Nombres 35:30) ;] 
__(a) prop., to be a witness, bear witness, testify: absol. (find., al.), Jean 15:27, Actes 26:5; parenthetical (Bl., § 79, 7; MM, xvi), 2 Corinthiens 8:3; with dative of person(s) (comm. and incomm.; El., § 37, 2), Actes 22:5, Hébreux 10:15; id. before ὅτι, Matthieu 23:31, Romains 10:2, al.; accusative and inf., Actes 10:43; with accusative of thing(s) (cl.), Jean 3:11, Apocalypse 22:16, 20; with accusative cogn., before περί, Jean 5:32, 1 Jean 5:10; with dative of thing(s), Jean 5:33, Actes 14:3, al.; before περί, with genitive (of person(s) and of thing(s)), Jean 1:7-8, 15 2:25 18:23 21:24, al.; id. before ὅτι, Jean 5:36 7:7; ὅτι, Jean 1:34 4:44 al.; ὅτι recit., Jean 4:39; κατά before ὅτι, 1 Corinthiens 15:15; pass., Hébreux 7:8; ptcp., Romains 3:21; impers., Hébreux 7:17; 
__(b) in late Gk., to witness favourably, give a good report, approve (Bl., § 54, 3; MM, xvi; Deiss., BS, 265): with dative of person(s), Luc 4:22; before ἐπί with dative of thing(s), Hébreux 11:4; pass., Actes 6:3; before ἐν, 1 Timothée 5:10, Hébreux 11:2; διά, with genitive of thing(s), Hébreux 11:39; with genitive of person(s), Actes 10:22, al.; impers., III Jn 12 (cf. ἐπι, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-μαρτυρέω)

G3141.def:
μαρτυρία, -ας, ἡ
(μαρτυρέω), [in LXX: Genèse 31:47 R (גַּלְעֵד), Exode 20:16, Deutéronome 5:20 (17), Proverbes 25:18, Psaumes 19:7 (עֵד, עֵדוּת), Proverbes 12:19, Sir.31:23-24, 4Ma.6:32 * ;] 
witness, testimony, evidence: Marc 14:56, Luc 22:71, Jean 5:34 19:35 21:24, 1 Timothée 3:7, Tite 1:13, 3Jn.12, Apocalypse 11:7; with genitive subj., Marc 14:59, Jean 8:17 (LXX aliter), 1 Jean 5:9; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), Marc 14:55; esp. of witness concerning Christ and divine things, Jean 1:7 3:11, 32-33 5:32, 36 Apocalypse 6:9; with genitive subj., Jean 1:19 5:31 8:13-14, Actes 22:18, 1 Jean 5:9-11, Apocalypse 12:11; with genitive obj., Apocalypse 1:2, 9 12:17 19:10 20:4; μ. ἔχειν, Apocalypse 6:9 12:17 19:10.†

G3142.def:
μαρτύριον, -ου, τό
(μάρτυρ) [in LXX chiefly for מוֹעֵד, also for עֵדָה, עֵדוּת and cogn. forms ;] 
a testimony, witness, proof (Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive subj., 2 Corinthiens 1:12, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:10; with genitive obj., Actes 4:33, 1 Corinthiens 1:6 2:1 (WH, txt., R, txt., μυστήριον; 2 Timothée 1:8; εἰς μ., Matthieu 8:4 10:18 Matthieu 24:14, Marc 1:44 6:11 13:9, Luc 5:14 9:5 21:13, Hébreux 3:5, Jacques 5:3; τὸ μ. καιροῖς ἰδίοις (CGT, in l), 1 Timothée 2:6; ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μ. (LXX for מוֹעֵד אֹהֶל), Actes 7:44, Apocalypse 15:5.†

G3143.def:
μαρτύρομαι
(μάρτυρ), [in LXX: Jdth.7:28, 1Ma.2:56 א)* ;] 
to summon as witness (M, Th., 25 f.; Hort., 1Pe., 53 f.; Lft., Notes, 29; Ga 203), hence, 
__(a) to protest, affirm solemnly: before ὅτι, Actes 20:26, Galates 5:3; 
__(b) to adjure, beseech: with dative of person(s), Actes 26:22; with accusative and inf., Éphésiens 4:17; before εἰς, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:12 (cf. δια-, προ-μαρτύρομαι).†

G3144.def:
μάρτυς
(Æolic μάρτυρ), -υρος, ὁ (also ἡ), [in LXX for עֵד ;] 
a witness: Actes 10:41, 1 Timothée 6:12, 2 Timothée 2:2, Hébreux 12:1 (Westc., in l); in forensic sense, Matthieu 18:16 26:65, Marc 14:63, Actes 6:13 7:58, 2 Corinthiens 13:1, 1 Timothée 5:19, Hébreux 10:28; with genitive obj., Luc 24:48, Actes 1:22 2:32 3:15 5:32 10:39 26:16, 1 Pierre 5:1; with genitive poss., Actes 1:8 13:31, Apocalypse 11:3; with dative of person(s), Luc 11:48, Actes 22:15; of Christ, Apocalypse 1:5 3:14; of God, Romains 1:9, 2 Corinthiens 1:23, Philippiens 1:8, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:5 2:10; of those who have witnessed for Christ by their death (in later Xn. lit., martyr: Swete, Ap., 35), Actes 22:20, Apocalypse 2:13 17:6.†

G3145.def:
μασάομαι (Rec. μασσ), -ῶμαι 
(Aristoph. and late writers, but not in Trag. or in good Att.. prose), [in LXX: Job 30:4 (לֶחֶם), Sir.19:9 A * ;] 
to bite, chew: Apocalypse 16:10.†

G3146.def:
μαστιγόω, -ῶ 
(μάστιξ) [in LXX chiefly for נָכָה hi. ;] 
to scourge: with accusative, Matthieu 10:17 20:19 23:34, Marc 10:34, Luc 18:33, Jean 19:1; metaphorically, Hébreux 12:6 (cf. Proverbes 3:12, Jérémie 5:3, Jdth.8:27).†

G3147.def:
μαστίζω
(Ep. and late prose = Att.. μαστιγόω) [in LXX: Nombres 22:25 (נָכָה hi.), Wis.5:11, 2Ma.2:21 * ;] 
to whip, scourge: with accusative, Actes 22:25.†

G3148.def:
μάστιξ, -ιγος, ἡ 
[in LXX for שׁוֹט, etc. ;] 
a whip, scourge: Actes 22:24, Hébreux 11:36; metaphorically, of disease or suffering as a divine chastisement (cf. Psaumes 89:33, Proverbes 3:12, 2Ma.9:11), Marc 3:10 5:29, 34, Luc 7:21

G3149.def:
μαστός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for שַׁד ;] 
the breast: pl., Luc 11:27 23:29, Apocalypse 1:13 (T, μασθοῖς; WH, App., 149; L, μαζοῖς).†

G3150.def:
ματαιολογία, -ας, ἡ
(ματαιολόγος), 
idle or foolish talk: 1 Timothée 1:6.†

G3152.def:
μάταιος, -ον
(as in Att.., but -αία, -αιον, 1 Corinthiens 15:17, 1 Pierre 1:18; μάτην), [in LXX for שָׁוְא, הֶבֶל, כָּזָב, etc. ;] 
vain, useless: ἀνωφελὴς κ. μ., Tite 3:9; πίστις, 1 Corinthiens 15:17; θρησκεία, Jacques 1:26; διαλογισμοί, 1 Corinthiens 3:20 (LXX); ἀναστροφή, 1 Pierre 1:18; of idols and heathen gods, τὰ μ. (Jérémie 2:5, 4Ki.17:15, al.): Actes 14:15 
SYN.: κενός, q.v

G3153.def:
ματαιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(μάταιος), [in LXX for הֶבֶל, Psaumes 31:6 39:5 62:9, al., and nearly 40 times in Ec; for שָׁוְא, Psaumes 25:4, al.; רִיק, etc. ;] 
vanity, emptiness, frailty, folly: Romains 8:20, 2 Pierre 2:18; τ. νοός, Éphésiens 4:17 (elsewhere only in Pollux, 6, 134, and Eccl.).†

G3154.def:
ματαιόω, -ῶ
(μάταιος), [in LXX: 4Ki.17:15, Jérémie 2:5, al. הָבַל, etc. ;] 
to make vain, foolish: Romains 1:21.†

G3155.def:
μάτην
(prop. accusative of μάτη, a fault, folly), adv., [in LXX for הָבַל, שָׁוְא, etc. ;] 
in vain, to no purpose: Matthieu 15:9, Marc 7:7" (LXX) .†

G3156.def:
Μαθθαῖος (Rec. Ματθ-, see WH, App., 159; Bl., § 3, 11; on the Semitic form, see Dalman, Words, 51; Gr., 142), -ου, ὁ, 
Matthew: Mt title., Matthieu 9:9 10:3, Marc 3:18, Luc 6:15, Actes 1:13 (cf. Λευεί).†

G3157.def:
Μαθθάν (Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), ὁ indecl. (Heb. מַתָּן), 
Matthan: Matthieu 1:15.†

G3158G.def:
Μαθθάτ (T, -άθ; Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. מַתָּת), 
Matthat: Luc 3:29 (cf. Ματθάτ).†
Matthat: Luc 3:24 (T, Μαθθάθ),†
Ματθάτ (see: Μαθθάτ),

G3158H.def:
Μαθθάτ (T, -άθ; Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. מַתָּת), 
Matthat: Luc 3:29 (cf. Ματθάτ).†
Matthat: Luc 3:24 (T, Μαθθάθ),†
Ματθάτ (see: Μαθθάτ),

G3159.def:
Μαθθίας (Rec. Ματθ-, see: Μαθθαῖος), -α, ὁ (Heb. מַתָּת), 
Matthias: Actes 1:23, 26.†

G3160.def:
Ματταθά, ὁ 
indecl. (Heb. מַתַּתָּה), 
Mattatha: Luc 3:31.†

G3162.def:
μάχαιρα, -ης
(Att.. -ας; see WH, App., 1568; ΒΙ., § 7, 1), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for חֶרֶב; also for מַאֲכֶלֶת, etc. ;] 
__1. (in Hom., al.) a large knife or dirk, for sacrificial purposes (Genèse 22:6, 10, Juges 19:20 A). 
__2. a short sword or dagger (as disting. from ῥομφαία, a large broad sword and ξίφος, a straight sword for thrusting): Matthieu 26:47 ff., Marc 14:43, 47-48, Luc 22:36 ff., Jean 18:10-11 Actes 16:27, Hébreux 11:37, Apocalypse 6:4 13:10, 14; στόμα μαχαίρης (as in Heb. חֶרֶב פֶּה, Genèse 34:26, al.), the edge of the sword: Luc 21:24, Hébreux 11:34; μ. δίστομος, Hébreux 4:12; ἀναιρεῖν μαχαίρῃ, Actes 12:2; τὴν μ. φορεῖν, Romains 13:4. Metaphorical, Matthieu 10:34 (opposite to εἰρήνη), Romains 8:35; μ. τοῦ πνεῦματος, Éphésiens 6:17.†

G3163.def:
μάχη, -ης, ἡ
(μάχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;] 
__1. a fight. 
__2. a strife, contention, quarrel: 2 Corinthiens 7:5, 2 Timothée 2:23, Jacques 4:1; pl., Tite 3:9.†

G3164.def:
μάχομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for רִיב, also for נָצָה ni., etc. ;] 
__1. to fight: Actes 7:26. 
__2. to quarrel, dispute: 2 Timothée 2:24, Jacques 4:2; πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Jean 6:52 (cf. δια-μάχομαι).†

G3165.def:
1. apostrophe for με. 
2. rarely for μοι, (Homer) (ML)

G3167.def:
μεγαλεῖος, -εία, -εῖον
(μέγας) [in LXX: Psaumes 71:19 (גָּדוֹל), al., frequently in Sir ;] 
magnificent, splendid (Xen., Plut., al.) : Actes 2:11.†

G3168.def:
μεγαλειότης, -ητος, ἡ
(μεγαλεῖος) [in LXX: Jérémie 33:9 (תִּפְאָרָה), Dan LXX 7:27, 1Es.1:5 Esther 4:40 * ;] 
splendour, magnificence: Luc 9:43, Actes 19:27, 2 Pierre 1:16 (frequently in π. as a ceremonial title, MM, xvi).†

G3169.def:
μεγαλοπρεπής, ές (= μεγάλῳ πρέπων), 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 33:26 (גַּאֲוָה) 2Ma.8:15 2Mac 15:13, 3Ma.2:9 * ;] 
befitting a great man, magnificent, majestic: 2 Pierre 1:17 (cf. MM, xvi).†

G3170.def:
μεγαλύνω
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for גָּדַל pi., hi. ;] 
__1. to make great: Matthieu 23:5, Luc 1:58. 
__2. to declare great, extol, magnify: Luc 1:46, Actes 5:13 10:46 19:17, 2 Corinthiens 10:15; pass., before ἐν, Philippiens 1:20.†

G3171.def:
μεγάλως 
adv., [in LXX for גָּדוֹל, etc. ;] 
greatly: Philippiens 4:10.†

G3172.def:
μεγαλωσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for גְּדוּלָה and cogn. forms, 2 Rois 7:23, Psaumes 145:3, al. ;] 
greatness, majesty: Hébreux 1:3 8:1, Ju 25 (elsewhere Eccl. only).†

G3174.def:
μέγεθος, -ους, τό
(μέγας) [in LXX chiefly for קוֹמָה ;] 
greatness: Éphésiens 1:19 (cf. MM, xvi, see word μέγας).†

G3175.def:
μεγιστάν, -ᾶνος, ὁ
(μέγιστος) [in LXX chiefly for שַׂר, Jérémie 24:8, al.; רַבְרְבָן, Dan LXX TH Daniel 5:23, al.; frequently in Sir (sing., Sir.4:7) ;] 
usually pl., οἱ μ., the chief men, nobles (Manetho, FlJ, al.): Marc 6:21, Apocalypse 6:15 18:23.†

G3177.def:
μεθερμηνεύω 
[in LXX: Sirach prologue 23 * ;] 
to translate, interpret: Matthieu 1:23, Marc 5:41 15:22, 34, Jean 1:38, 42, Actes 4:36 13:8 (cf. ἑρμηνεύω).†

G3178.def:
μέθη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַר and cognate forms ;] 
drunkenness: Luc 21:34; pl., Romains 13:13, Galates 5:21 †
SYN.: see: κῶμος

G3179.def:
μεθ-ίστημι and (late form, 1 Corinthiens 13:2) μεθιστάνω, 
[in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;] 
trans. in Pres., impf., fut. and aor. 1, 
to change, remove: with accusative of thing(s), ὄρη, 1 Corinthiens 13:2 (cf. Ésaïe 54:10); with accusative of person(s): before εἰς, Colossiens 1:13; before ἐκ, pass., Luc 16:4; of causing death (cf. similar intrans. sense, Eur., Alc., 21, al.), Actes 13:22. Metaphorical (cf. τ. καρδίαν μ., Josué 14:8), with accusative of person(s), to pervert: Actes 19:26.†

G3180.def:
μεθ-οδία (Rec. -εία; cf. 131., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ 
(† μεθοδεύω, 1. to treat by rule. 2. to employ craft: 4Ki.19:27 *) 
craft, deceit: Éphésiens 4:14 6:11 (not found elsewhere; see AR, in l).†

G3182.def:
μεθύσκω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 23:5 (רָוָה), Proverbes 4:17 (שָׁתָה), etc. ;] 
causal of μεθύω, 
to make drunk, intoxicate; pass., to get drunk: Luc 12:45, Éphésiens 5:18, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:7.†

G3183.def:
μέθυσος, -α, -ον
(also -ος, -ον; prop., only of women, but in late writers also = μεθυστικός, of men), [in LXX: Proverbes 23:21 (סָבָא) Proverbes 26:9 (שִׁכּוֹר), Sir.19:1 26:8, 4Ma.2:7 * ;] 
drunken: 1 Corinthiens 5:11 6:10.†

G3184.def:
μεθύω
(μέθυ, wine, cf. μέθη), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַר, רָוָה ;] 
to be drunken: Matthieu 24:49, Jean 2:10, Actes 2:15, 1 Corinthiens 11:21, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:7; metaphorically, Apocalypse 17:2, 6.†

G3188.def:
μέλαν, τό, see: μέλας.
μέλας, -αινα, -αν genitive, -ανος, -αίνης, -ανος, 
[in LXX: Cantique des cantiques 1:5, Zacharie 6:2 (שָׁחֹר), etc. ;] 
black: Apocalypse 6:5, 12; opposite to λευκός, Matthieu 5:36; neut., τὸ μ., ink : 2 Corinthiens 3:3, II Jn 12, 3Jn.13.†

G3189.def:
μέλας, -αινα, -αν genitive, -ανος, -αίνης, -ανος, 
[in LXX: Cantique des cantiques 1:5, Zacharie 6:2 (שָׁחֹר), etc. ;] 
black: Apocalypse 6:5, 12; opposite to λευκός, Matthieu 5:36; neut., τὸ μ., ink : 2 Corinthiens 3:3, II Jn 12, 3Jn.13.†

G3190.def:
Μελεά (Rec. -ᾶς, genitive, -ᾶ) 
indecl., ὁ (Heb. מְלֵאָה), 
Melea: Luc 3:31.†

G3191.def:
μελετάω, -ῶ
(μελέτη, care), [in LXX chiefly for הָגָה m ;] 
__1. with genitive, to care for (Hes.). 
__2. C. accusative to attend to, practise: 1 Timothée 4:15 (RV, be diligent in; cf. Souter in Exp., VIII, vi, 429, but see infr.). 
__3. to study, ponder: Actes 4:25 (LXX) 1 Timothée 4:15 (AV, meditate on; cf. CGT, in l, but see supr.; cf. προ-μελετάω).†

G3192.def:
μέλι, -τος, τό 
[in LXX frequently (Genèse 43:11, al.) for דְּבַשׁ; for נֹפֶת, Proverbes 5:3 ;] 
honey: Apocalypse 10:9-10; ἄγριον (which see), Matthieu 3:4, Marc 1:9.†

G3193.def:
μελίσσιος, -α, -ον
(elsewhere † -αῖος, -ειος; μέλισσα, a bee, cf. μέλι), 
made by bees: Luc 24:42 (Rec., WH, R, mg.).†

G3194.def:
Μελίτη (Rec., R, txt.), Μελιτήνη (WH, R, mg., see WH, App., 160), 
Melita, Melitene (mod. Malta) : Actes 28:1.†

G3196.def:
μέλος, -ους, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for נֵתַח ;] 
a member, limb of the body: 1 Corinthiens 12:14 12:19 12:26 Éphésiens 4:16 (WH, mg.), Jacques 3:5; pl. (as always in cl.), τὰ μ. : Matthieu 5:29-30, Romains 6:13, 19 7:5, 23 12:4, 1 Corinthiens 12:12 ff, Colossiens 3:5, Jacques 3:6 4:1. Metaphorical, πόρνης, 1 Corinthiens 6:15; of Christians, μ. ἀλλήλων, Romains 12:5, Éphésiens 4:25; Χριστοῦ, 1 Corinthiens 6:15; σώματος Χριστοῦ, 1 Corinthiens 12:27, Éphésiens 5:30.†

G3197G.def:
Μελχεί (Rec. -χί), indecl., ὁ (Heb. מֶלֶךְ), 
Melchi: Luc 3:24, 28.†

G3197H.def:
Μελχεί (Rec. -χί), indecl., ὁ (Heb. מֶלֶךְ), 
Melchi: Luc 3:24, 28.†

G3198.def:
Μελχισεδέκ indecl., ὁ (Heb. מַלְכִּי־צֶדֶק), 
Melchizedek: Hébreux 5:6, 10 6:20 7:1, 10-11 7:15, 17.†

G3199.def:
μέλω 
[in LXX: Job 22:3 (חֵפֶץ), Tob.10:5, Wis.12:13, 1Ma.14:42-43 * ;] 
__1. intrans., to be an object of care, be a care; commonly in third of person(s): with dative of person(s), Actes 18:17; very frequently impers., 1 Corinthiens 7:21; before ὅτι, Marc 4:38, Luc 10:40; with genitive of thing(s) (as frequently in Att..), 1 Corinthiens 9:9; before περί, Matthieu 22:16, Marc 12:14, Jean 10:13 12:6, 1 Pierre 5:7. 
__2. Trans., in act. and mid., to care for (not in LXX or NT).†
